verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete. The two hermetic guards are preserved as the first executable checks after checkout in the gating gui-mock-ipc job, with no advisory-registry declaration, continue-on-error, job-level condition, or dependency that would weaken their blocking behavior.
